HRS 2010 Final Release

Note to Users: This codebook is designed to match the distribution dataset. 
Codebook metadata are derived from the data collection instrument.
If you have questions concerning codebook layout or content please bring
them to the attention of the HRS staff at hrsquestions@umich.edu.

Printing recommendation: Set margins (left/right/top/bottom) to .5 inch; print
in portrait orientation using a mono-space 10-point font.

         ASSIGN: X026_MainST.ASK 
         IF ((Preload_RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> NEWPOSTEXIT) AND 
         (Preload_RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> FIRSTREPEATPOST)) AND 
         (Preload_RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> SECREPEATPOST) THEN 
         IF (Preload_HH.X024_ReIwHH_V = YES) OR ((Preload_HH.X024_ReIwHH_V <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.StartInterview.A007TRAlive_A = YES)) THEN 
         IF SecA.HousingLocation.A110TStophouseAssignments = RESPONSE THEN 
         IF (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN804805) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = EMPTY AND 
         (((SecA.HousingLocation.A071_SameMainRes <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A072_SameAreaMain <> YES)) AND 
         SecA.HousingLocation.A075TCurResCty_A <> EMPTY)) THEN 
         HH.X026_MainST := A076TCurResST_A 
         IF (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN778b) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = EMPTY AND 
         (((SecA.HousingLocation.A071_SameMainRes <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A073_Same2ndRes = YES)) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A074_SameArea2nd = YES))) THEN 
         HH.X026_MainST := piPreload_HHX030_2ndResST 
         IF SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN811812 THEN 
         HH.X026_MainST := A081TOthResST_A 
         IF SecA.HousingLocation.NursingHome.A070_NHOwnRent = NO THEN 
         HH.X026_MainST := NursingHome.A068_STNHome 
         ELSE 
         IF (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN804805) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = EMPTY AND 
         (((SecA.HousingLocation.A071_SameMainRes <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A072_SameAreaMain <> YES)) AND 
         SecA.HousingLocation.A075TCurResCty_A <> EMPTY)) THEN 
         HH.X026_MainST := A076TCurResST_A 
         IF (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN778b) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = EMPTY AND 
         (((SecA.HousingLocation.A071_SameMainRes <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A073_Same2ndRes = YES)) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A074_SameArea2nd = YES))) THEN 
         HH.X026_MainST := piPreload_HHX030_2ndResST 
         IF SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN811812 THEN 
         HH.X026_MainST := A081TOthResST_A 
         IF SecA.HousingLocation.NursingHome.A070_NHOwnRent = NO THEN 
         HH.X026_MainST := NursingHome.A068_STNHome 

         - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

         ASSIGN: X033_HHMoved.ASK 
         IF ((Preload_RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> NEWPOSTEXIT) AND 
         (Preload_RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> FIRSTREPEATPOST)) AND 
         (Preload_RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> SECREPEATPOST) THEN 
         IF (Preload_HH.X024_ReIwHH_V = YES) OR ((Preload_HH.X024_ReIwHH_V <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.StartInterview.A007TRAlive_A = YES)) THEN 
         IF SCV.XR1_R2 = FIRST THEN 
         IF ((SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN804805) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN778b)) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN811812) THEN 
         IF SecA.HousingLocation.A072_SameAreaMain = YES THEN 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := CHANGEDRES 
         ELSE 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := MOVEDOUTAREA 
         ELSE 
         IF (SecA.HousingLocation.A071_SameMainRes <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A072_SameAreaMain <> YES) THEN 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := MOVEDOUTAREA 
         ELSE 
         IF (SecA.HousingLocation.A071_SameMainRes <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A072_SameAreaMain = YES) THEN 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := CHANGEDRES 
         ELSE 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := RDIDNTMOVE 
         ELSE 
         IF SCV.XR1_R2 = SECOND THEN 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := piPreload_HHX033_HHMoved 
         ELSE 
         IF SCV.XR1_R2 = FIRST THEN 
         IF ((SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN804805) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN778b)) OR 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A085_WhichMainRes = HOMEIN811812) THEN 
         IF SecA.HousingLocation.A072_SameAreaMain = YES THEN 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := CHANGEDRES 
         ELSE 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := MOVEDOUTAREA 
         ELSE 
         IF (SecA.HousingLocation.A071_SameMainRes <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A072_SameAreaMain <> YES) THEN 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := MOVEDOUTAREA 
         ELSE 
         IF (SecA.HousingLocation.A071_SameMainRes <> YES) AND 
         (SecA.HousingLocation.A072_SameAreaMain = YES) THEN 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := CHANGEDRES 
         ELSE 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := RDIDNTMOVE 
         ELSE 
         IF SCV.XR1_R2 = SECOND THEN 
         HH.X033_HHMoved := piPreload_HHX033_HHMoved 

         - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

         FIRSTREPEATPOST)) AND (RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> SECREPEATPOST) THEN 
         IF (piRTab1X007AFinFam = FAMILYR) OR (piRTab1X007AFinFam = FINANCIAL_FAMILYR) 
         THEN 
         IF (ACTIVELANGUAGE <> EXTENG) AND (ACTIVELANGUAGE <> EXTSPN) THEN 
         IF (Children[Cnt].X056AresStat <> DIED) AND (Children[Cnt].X061ARelateR IN 
         [SON, STEPSON, DAUGHTER, STEPDAUGHTER, SPPOFSON, SPPOFDAUGHTER]) THEN 
         IF piX056AresStat <> DELETED THEN 
         IF ((piX056AresStat <> DIED) AND (piX056AresStat <> HAVENOCONTACT)) AND 
         piX054APNdx <> EMPTY THEN 
         IF ptX067AYrBorn = EMPTY THEN 
         IF (piX061ARelateR IN [SON, STEPSON, DAUGHTER, STEPDAUGHTER, UNKNOWNCHILD, 
         SPPOFSON, SPPOFDAUGHTER, UNKNOWNINLAW]) OR ((piX056AresStat IN [RESIDENT]) AND 
         NOT (piX061ARelateR IN [FATHER, FATHEROFSPP, MOTHER, MOTHEROFSPP])) THEN 
         IF SecE.LongKidLoop.childquestions_E027[Cnt].E027A = RESPONSE THEN 
         ptX067AYrBorn := Today.YEAR - E027A

         ASSIGN: X067AYrBorn.ASK 
         IF ((RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> NEWPOSTEXIT) AND (RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> 
         FIRSTREPEATPOST)) AND (RVARS.Z145_TypeExit_V <> SECREPEATPOST) THEN 
         IF (piRTab1X007AFinFam = FAMILYR) OR (piRTab1X007AFinFam = FINANCIAL_FAMILYR) 
         THEN 
         IF (ACTIVELANGUAGE <> EXTENG) AND (ACTIVELANGUAGE <> EXTSPN) THEN 
         IF (Children[Cnt].X056AresStat <> DIED) AND (Children[Cnt].X061ARelateR IN 
         [SON, STEPSON, DAUGHTER, STEPDAUGHTER, SPPOFSON, SPPOFDAUGHTER]) THEN 
         IF piX056AresStat <> DELETED THEN

         imagine yourself in these situations and that your answer will be the same as
         what you would actually do.
